evidence.title: Rahm to leave LIV Golf over 'unacceptable' terms

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing transcript and player statements
occurrences.quote_span: There was no indication given regarding these players' positions in relation to LIV 2.0.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court docket
occurrences.quote_span: This matter has therefore been pushed back to a hearing on 14 October.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: Ted Goldthorpe interview and LIV 2.0 player signings by October 25
occurrences.quote_span: Ted Goldthorpe, head of BC Partners Credit, told BBC Sport on Tuesday he was "confident" they would get the required number and calibre of players to sign up for LIV 2.0 by the new deadline of 25 October.
occurrences.speaker: Ted Goldthorpe
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: signed termination agreement and Garcia contract records
occurrences.quote_span: Once that termination agreement is signed, it is understood Garcia will be free to negotiate with third parties.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: Ted Goldthorpe interview
occurrences.quote_span: Asked about conversations with players, he said: "I'm not that worried, I'm honestly not that worried about it. I don't think we have a hard deadline for a number of players or who those players are. But we feel pretty confident we have critical mass."
occurrences.speaker: Ted Goldthorpe
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing docket
occurrences.quote_span: It is hoped this will be finalised by a court hearing on 5 November.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Lawyers for several other players, including Bryson DeChambeau and Cameron Smith, also spoke in the hearing to seek clarity on whether the rejection of the contracts equated to termination of the contracts.
occurrences.speaker: Lawyers for LIV Golf players
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: LIV Golf bankruptcy claims register and player contracts
occurrences.quote_span: LIV's participants are owed at least $45m (£33m) and have the option to leave.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: Sergio Garcia's Open de Espana media remarks
occurrences.quote_span: Earlier he had told media at the Open de Espana in Madrid how keen he is to be involved in next year's Ryder Cup as a player or vice-captain.
occurrences.speaker: Sergio Garcia
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing transcript or order on Sergio Garcia's LIV contract
occurrences.quote_span: Meanwhile, former Masters champion Sergio Garcia was granted a special "deal" during Wednesday's hearing in New Jersey allowing his contract to be "terminated" as well as "rejected", following an application by his lawyers.
occurrences.speaker: New Jersey bankruptcy court
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: LIV 2.0 player agreements and bankruptcy court filings
occurrences.quote_span: BBC Sport understands there is no obligation on players to sign on to LIV 2.0, regardless of whether they had previously signed multi-year contracts with LIV Golf.
occurrences.speaker: BBC Sport
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: Sergio Garcia media interview at the Open de Espana
occurrences.quote_span: While he said that he was not sure what his future held and "everything is an option", he made clear he wanted to give himself "the best chance" of making the Ryder Cup team.
occurrences.speaker: Sergio Garcia
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Rahm's lawyer, John Beck, told the hearing the 31-year-old Spaniard "independently reviewed the terms of LIV 2.0 and determined those terms are unacceptable as to him".
occurrences.speaker: John Beck
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: LIV Golf bankruptcy claims register
occurrences.quote_span: Documents outlining the money owed to LIV Golf's creditors, with the 30 largest unsecured claims, show that two-time major winner Rahm tops the list with an unsecured claim of $7.5m (£5.5m).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: BC Partners Credit investment documents and statements
occurrences.quote_span: He added that BC Partners was wanting to be involved with LIV for the "long-term".
occurrences.speaker: Ted Goldthorpe
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Keith Martorana, counsel for LIV Golf, said: "We are not looking to hold anybody up unduly but we have unfortunately at this point had no opportunity to review those contracts."
occurrences.speaker: Keith Martorana
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: Jon Rahm's prior public statements about joining LIV
occurrences.quote_span: He has previously said he had no regrets over joining LIV and backed organisers to make it sustainable.
occurrences.speaker: Jon Rahm
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing transcript
occurrences.quote_span: One lawyer, representing five players including Smith, said clarity was needed on whether players could engage in discussions about "future plans with third parties".
occurrences.speaker: lawyer representing five LIV Golf players
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: DP World Tour communications and player contract-termination records
occurrences.quote_span: The DP World Tour, for example, is understood to be unwilling to have discussions with LIV players surrounding their futures unless they have proof that their contracts have been terminated.
occurrences.speaker: DP World Tour
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing transcript
occurrences.quote_span: However, lawyers representing LIV did not agree to apply the same arrangement that Garcia had received, instead asking for more time to assess player contracts and the consequences of termination.
occurrences.speaker: LIV Golf's lawyers
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: LIV transaction communications and bankruptcy court filings
occurrences.quote_span: LIV insiders remain positive about the future, saying conversations with players are on track and the statements made in court have not changed the momentum behind the transaction.
occurrences.speaker: LIV insiders
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court agreement or hearing order
occurrences.quote_span: However, the agreement secures an extension for the league to discuss terms with its players, with talks now open until 25 October.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing record or separation-agreement filings
occurrences.quote_span: It was later said that LIV and Rahm's representatives are "in advanced discussions for a consensual separation agreement between Mr Rahm and LIV".
occurrences.speaker: LIV and Jon Rahm's representatives
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: Ted Goldthorpe interview and LIV 2.0 restructuring plans
occurrences.quote_span: "The next focus for us is going to be to sign players, which we're going to work on for the next month. In parallel to that, we're going to be business planning, event planning, rehiring the staff, you know, and revitalising the LIV. I'm spending a lot of time on this right now."
occurrences.speaker: Ted Goldthorpe
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing

occurrences.checkable_against: bankruptcy court hearing transcript or filing concerning Jon Rahm and LIV 2.0
occurrences.quote_span: Jon Rahm will leave LIV Golf after deeming the proposed terms for LIV 2.0 "unacceptable", his lawyer has told a bankruptcy court hearing.
occurrences.speaker: John Beck
occurrences.subject: LIV Golf bankruptcy court hearing
